newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian banks free to fix working capital limits.
newsitem.headline: Indian banks free to fix working capital limits.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) on Tuesday said banks would be given full operational freedom to assess the working capital requirements of their borrowers.

"Accordingly, banks are now free to evolve their own methods of assessing the working capital requirements of borrowers within the prudential guidelines and exposure of norms already prescribed," it said in a letter to banks.

"The loan policy in respect of each broad category of industry shall be laid down by every bank with the approval of its board," the RBI said as part of its credit policy for the first half of fiscal 1997/98 (April-March).
